name: DAAR Coms
source: Daar Communications Plc statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), six months column, N'000 scaled to NGN. The filing prints no taxation line and no profit before tax line; profit before tax is the printed profit before taxation and taxation is printed as a dash, which is stored as zero charge. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20260929: audited statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 2025 (N'000); profit before tax, tax, net profit, finance cost and EBIT corrected to the printed lines | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the Daar Communications Plc statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, nine months column, printed in N thousand and stored as absolute naira. Revenue 4,919,108; cost of sales 2,412,412; gross profit 2,506,696; other income 37,612; selling expenses 176,679 plus administrative expenses 1,470,672 gives operating expenses 1,647,351; the printed subtotal after other income is 2,544,308 and operating profit 896,957 is that subtotal less the two expense lines; finance cost 112,647; profit before taxation 784,310; taxation printed as nil; profit for the period 784,310; EPS printed 10 kobo. The same 784,310 appears as the period movement in the statement of changes in equity, which confirms the column. Ties exactly.

unitGuard.reason: Withheld: the EPS row reads 341 for FY2025, the OPPOSITE sign to the net profit reported for the same period (-8.74657e+08), and its magnitude is 3119x that period's net profit divided by the shares on file (-0.109332) - a figure of a different order, not a share-count basis difference. The inputs on file do not recover the printed per-share figure, so nothing is published for this period. A blank is honest; a per-share figure whose sign contradicts its own period's earnings is not.

Withheld: the EPS row reads 715 for FY2024, the OPPOSITE sign to the net profit reported for the same period (-2.34172e+09), and its magnitude is 2443x that period's net profit divided by the shares on file (-0.292714) - a figure of a different order, not a share-count basis difference. The inputs on file do not recover the printed per-share figure, so nothing is published for this period. unit guard: the EPS row for 9M 2026 read 100 against 0.0980387 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 1020, which is the 1000x multiple of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.1, the unit the price is quoted in.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
rows.formula: Net Profit / weighted average shares implied by the company's own reported EPS
